text: ① 15:00 德国9月工业产出； ② 17:30 美国纽约联储主席威廉姆斯在德国参与欧洲央行组织的讨论； ③ 美股盘前 莫德纳发布业绩报告； ④ 19:00 瑞士央行管委会成员Petra Tschudin在德国法兰克福讲话； ⑤ 20:15 英国央行首席经济学家Pill（在央行加息次日）讲话； ⑥ 21:30 美国10月非农就业报告（含就业人口、失业率、平均每小时工资），加拿大10月就业人数、失业率； ⑦ 22:10 美国圣路易斯联储主席Musalem讲话； ⑧ 23:00 美国11月密歇根大学消费者信心指数初值； ⑨ 次日01:15 美联储理事、负责
text_en: ① 15:00 Germany September industrial production; ② 17:30 New York Fed President Williams participates in a discussion organized by the ECB in Germany; ③ Pre-market in the US: Moderna releases its earnings report; ④ 19:00 SNB Governing Board member Petra Tschudin speaks in Frankfurt, Germany; ⑤ 20:15 BoE Chief Economist Pill speaks (the day after the central bank's rate hike); ⑥ 21:30 US October nonfarm payrolls report (including employment, unemployment rate, average hourly earnings); Canada October employment and unemployment rate; ⑦ 22:10 St. Louis Fed President Musalem speaks; ⑧ 23:00 Preliminary US November University of Michigan consumer sentiment index; ⑨ 01:15 the next day: Fed Governor, responsible for
